notes: Music, tidied up: one clear row for Songs, Playlists and sorting, Play and Shuffle side by side, and a Now playing screen that shows the queue beside the song when the device is on its side. No more broken labels on phones. Calculator, easier to find your way: three fixed sections under the editor (Result, Functions, Saved), a functions catalog whose areas open to their topics, and keys that stand beside your work in landscape instead of covering it.
